notes.title: New options UPDATE!
notes.content:
OVERVIEW:

📏 Added height adjustment option
🔧 Easier Valve Index calibration
🐛 Fixed various bugs
🗣️ Completed missing text localizations
🤩 Improved overall gameplay experience

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Players can now take advantage of the new 'Adjust Height' option in OVRDARK, allowing seamless play across a wider range of software and devices without needing external calibration!

Valve Index players can now experience the convenience of our new 'Valve Index' calibration, automatically adjusting settings like hand offsets and height for their specific devices.

We fixed some minor bugs you reported and made some adjustments on lighting and fine-tuned collisions based on your feedback.

We are working hard 💪 to make OVRDARK the VR experience you were looking for!

notes.title: OVRDARK available on Thursday, 23rd May
notes.content:
[b]OVRDARK will finally be available on Thursday, the 23rd, at 12:00 AM (CEST)!
[/b]
To celebrate,[b] we're giving away 10 keys[/b]. Check out [url=https://x.com/NoxNoctisStudio/status/1790771665191776444]our post on Twitter[/url] to learn how to get one!

--

Relive the nightmare and step into the shoes of George Foster, Mike Goreng’s former lab
partner. Unveil the truth behind your best friend's tragic suicide and find the cure for the
pandemic that is threatening humanity, which key is hidden within Mike's family mansion's walls.

The game incorporates features such as:
[list]
[*] - [b]Stealth Mechanics[/b]: Navigate carefully to avoid Mike Goreng's detection, involving slow movement without sudden gestures and holding still without moving your hands or head.
[*] - [b]Immersive Sensory Experience[/b]: Features spatial sound powered by FMOD and controller vibrations for critical moments, low supplies, and special sequences. Intuitive haptic feedback aids in puzzle navigation.
[*] - [b]Seamless Exploration[/b]: Minimized loading screens for uninterrupted exploration of the vast mansion and core storyline.
[/list] 
Discover what terrible events have occurred in your best friend’s house while trying
to maintain your own sanity. Your mission: Find Mikes’ family. Find the cure that can save the
world. Good luck! ːsteammockingː

notes.title: OVRDARK, Coming Very Soon
notes.content:
